name: object_partner
title: Object partner
description: Partner assignments of technical objects, notifications and orders.
tested_release: none (draft, ECC 6.0 on NetWeaver 7.40 SP08 assumed)

no_dcl_by_design.ZEMX_I_ObjectPartner: Migration view on ECC: it must return every record of the object. Access is controlled by the user / RFC user of the load program and the extraction channel (S_TABU_NAM), not by CDS access control (decision XGEN-D01; CDS access control also needs a newer release than the 7.40 SP08 baseline).
